source.note: Injection string = AgentDojo's own attack class output for this (user task, injection task) pair. User turn = the user task's PROMPT; tool call = the ground-truth call whose output carries the injection vector (AgentDojo canary method). The tool result carries only the injection string (T6 convention): the surrounding environment data is omitted.
